title: koelreuteria elegans subsp. formosana
intro: Koelreuteria elegans subsp. formosana, commonly known as the Formosan pagoda tree or Chinese tree of heaven, is a plant species native to Taiwan. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Koelreuteria elegans subsp. formosana are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, fever, and cough, as well as its expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its therapeutic potential.
